examples.title: Flight of the Fjord  One of the most beautiful landscapes I have ever seen with my own eyes. Just stunning! This flight was above the world famous Geirangerfjord, part of the West Norwegian Fjords UNESCO World Heritage site and the only natural UNESCO site in all of Norway. Conditions were relatively good with a slight tailwind up top, which meant we had to be careful on the exit. The flight itself was incredible. I'll be dreaming about that flatter rocky terrain for years to come, then punching through the small cloud before landing in a beautiful grassy field. This jump really had it all!
